text:
maria: Quick heads-up — incoming pentest intake doc from AcmeSec. Proposed window Apr 14-16 UTC. Can we lock staging readroom and ephemeral roles?
aj: +1. What scope are they requesting? staging only or include prod read-only slices?
maria: Staging + read-only prod log snapshots. Link: https://acmesec.example/intake (sensitive)
kyle: For ephemeral roles, we need an RBAC mapping. Proposal: role `pen-test-assessor` with S3 read-only on `logs/` and CloudWatch Logs read. They will need KMS decrypt for log bundles — prefer short-lived grants.
liyah: KMS approach: create a timeboxed grant via key policy proxy. Recommend grant TTL=72h and explicit EncryptionContext constraint. Also ensure CloudTrail exports to evidence-bucket encrypted with a separate key.
sam: Retest gate idea: require (1) PR with fix merged, (2) staging validation run, (3) evidence uploaded to evidence-locker, (4) on-call ops sign-off. Retest window = 7 days after fix merged.
maria: We should also add a root-cause triage template. Fields: severity, repro steps, implicated components, PR link, owner, ETA, verification steps.
aj: I'll create JIRA board and labels pen-test/critical, pen-test/high etc. Also will set log-sampling to 100% during the window.
penops-bot: action: ephemeral role `pen-test-assessor` created — expires 2024-04-16T03:00Z
maria: One ask: do we allow them to test authz escalation? I'd prefer to prohibit destructive or key exfil tests. We'll confirm in SOW.
kyle: Agreed — SOW must forbid destructive testing and key extraction attempts. Also prepare a kill-switch: revoke grants + rotate grant token. We'll script a revoke endpoint.
liyah: Ops checklist item: ensure SIEM retention >=90d and collect CloudTrail pre-signed snapshots. Also snapshot index patterns and hash them into evidence manifest.
sam: Quick KMS example for the grant (ops):
```bash
aws kms create-grant \  --key-id alias/log-bundle-key \  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/pen-test-assessor \  --operations Decrypt Encrypt \  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pentest"}
```
maria: perfect. aj — can you own the retest-gate checklist?
aj: I'll own it. Checklist will include: evidence link, replay logs, synthetic smoke tests, KMS grant audit, RBAC diff, on-call sign-off. I'll post it by EOD.
maria: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC in #eng-security for final ops cadence. :thumbsup:
